...
I'm trying to run the SUPER Planner on a drone using a Jetson Orin Nano (8GB RAM) and a Cube Orange flight controller with PX4. Since I have a tight budget and will be running several heavy nodes (SUPER Planner, Fast LIO 2, PX4 bridge, ROG Map), I need to confirm: Is 8GB of shared RAM enough to handle all this in real-time without crashing the drone, especially considering the high data load from Fast LIO 2? If 8GB is pushing it, what's the minimum recommended RAM or JetPack version? Also, are there any specific MAVROS setup tricks or pitfalls I should know about when connecting the Orin Nano to the Cube Orange/PX4?
